keyfile.description: Path to the keyfile used to store/retrieve cryptographic state.

ipv4_method.description: Scrambling method for IPv4 addresses. One of: SCRAMBLE_NONE, SCRAMBLE_AES, SCRAMBLE_BLOWFISH.

ipv6_method.description: Scrambling method for IPv6 addresses. One of: SCRAMBLE_NONE, SCRAMBLE_AES, SCRAMBLE_BLOWFISH.

pass_bits.description: Number of leading bits to pass through unchanged. If 0, classful prefix is preserved.

enable_mac.description: Whether to enable MAC address scrambling (requires MAC_METHOD setting).

mac_method.description: Scrambling method for MAC addresses (used only if enable_mac is true). One of: SCRAMBLE_NONE, SCRAMBLE_AES.
